title: The Appointed Feasts

questions.question: What weekly feast was listed first?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:3 (ESV): "Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest."

questions.question: When is the Lord's Passover?
options: First month, fourteenth day at twilight
questions.correctAnswer: First month, fourteenth day at twilight
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:5 (ESV): "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight, is the Lord's Passover."

questions.question: How long is the Feast of Unleavened Bread?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:6 (ESV): "Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread."

questions.question: What feast occurs 50 days (seven full weeks) after the Sabbath of Firstfruits?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:15-16 (ESV): "You shall count seven full weeks... you shall count fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath."

questions.question: When is the Day of Atonement?
options: The tenth day of the seventh month
The first day of the seventh month
The fifteenth day of the seventh month
The first day of the first month
questions.correctAnswer: The tenth day of the seventh month
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:27 (ESV): "Now on the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement."

questions.question: What feast begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:34 (ESV): "On the fifteenth day of this seventh month and for seven days is the Feast of Booths."

questions.question: What memorial is held on the first day of the seventh month?
options: A day of solemn rest proclaimed with blast of trumpets
questions.correctAnswer: A day of solemn rest proclaimed with blast of trumpets
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:24 (ESV): "In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall observe a day of solemn rest, a memorial proclaimed with blast of trumpets."

questions.question: What were they to bring to the priest for the Firstfruits?
options: A sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest
questions.correctAnswer: A sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:10 (ESV): "Then you shall bring the sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest."

questions.question: What happens to the person who does any work on the Day of Atonement?
options: I will destroy that person from among his people
questions.correctAnswer: I will destroy that person from among his people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:30 (ESV): "And whoever does any work on that very day, that person I will destroy from among his people."

questions.question: Why did the Israelites live in booths?
options: That your generations may know that I made the people of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: That your generations may know that I made the people of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:43 (ESV): "That your generations may know that I made the people of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt."

questions.question: What offering was waved with the bread of the firstfruits (Pentecost)?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:19-20 (ESV): "And two male lambs a year old... priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits."

questions.question: How long did the Feast of Booths last?
options: Eight days (Seven plus the eighth day solemn assembly)
questions.correctAnswer: Eight days (Seven plus the eighth day solemn assembly)
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:36 (ESV): "Seven days... on the eighth day... a solemn assembly."

questions.question: What is the "Sabbath of Sabbaths" referring to here?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:32 (ESV): "It shall be to you a Sabbath of solemn rest (Sabbath of Sabbaths)."

questions.question: During the Feast of Booths, what kinds of branches were used?
options: Palm, willow, leafy trees, and fruit trees
questions.correctAnswer: Palm, willow, leafy trees, and fruit trees
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:40 (ESV): "Fruit of splendid trees, branches of palm trees and boughs of leafy trees and willows of the brook."

questions.question: These feasts are described as "holy convocations". What does that mean?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 23:2 (ESV): "The appointed feasts of the Lord that you shall proclaim as holy convocations."

key_verse_text: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, These are the appointed feasts of the Lord that you shall proclaim as holy convocations; they are my appointed feasts.
